Description
: Bring a touch of industrial history to your space with this collection of 10 assorted color Hemingray glass insulators. Each piece offers its unique patina, displaying hues of clear, aqua, and light green glass with vintage charm and visible air bubbles, mold seams, and embossed markings. These insulators, once used on telegraph and telephone poles, now offer collectors and decorators a glimpse into classic American utility design. Whether grouped together or displayed individually, their rounded shapes and subtle imperfections enhance their visual appeal. The glass construction ensures long-lasting durability, while the recognizable Hemingray embossing adds legitimacy and collector value. Ideal for display in a curio cabinet, as paperweights, or for upcycling in home decor projects, this lot brings both style and history. title: Polished Fluorite Heart Specimen Raw Mineral River Stone & Seashell Lot 4pc
description:
Natural Specimens
Polished Fluorite Heart and Raw Stone Collection
Mineral, Stone, and Seashell Set
Approx. 1" to 1.75" Dimensions
Unsigned
This eclectic collection features four distinct natural elements, headlined by a hand-polished green and blue fluorite heart. The fluorite exhibits characteristic translucency and internal crystalline structures typical of the mineral. Accompanying the heart is a weathered river stone with a smooth, water-worn texture, a raw mineral specimen with granular surface detail, and a naturally aged bivalve seashell with distinct ribbing and radial symmetry.
Polished fluorite heart displays vibrant shades of teal and forest green
Rough mineral specimen features crystalline inclusions and earthy tones
Natural bivalve seashell shows classic radial symmetry and weathered white finish
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. The fluorite heart is polished to a high gloss with minor internal fissures typical of the mineral. The raw stones and shell show natural textures, weathering, and geological characteristics consistent with their natural and geological origins.

title: Hemingray & Glass Insulators 3 Piece Lot Aqua Teal Clear Vintage
description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.
